welcomeLine: Ready to learn something new today? Today's lab simulations are waiting below.
emptyDashBody: They will be listed here when teachers send one.
resultsSubtitle: Academic assessment and roster summary center
rosterReady: Entered in the official roster archive
rosterLockedBody: Every subject for this semester is complete, and your class rank is recorded in the main archive.
rosterPendingBody: The semester and year summary is calculated after every teacher locks their marks. You can follow the current assessments now.
draftEmpty: There is no unfinished draft assessment. All of them are summarized.
lockedHeading: 2. Completed results locked into the roster
lockedEmpty: No subject is fully locked and approved yet.
draftHighBody: The mark is currently at a very high level. Keep your focus on the remaining assessments and hold this level.
draftMidBody: Work the remaining classwork and homework carefully so the mark can move higher.
draftLowBody: This assessment is below the pass mark. The result is not locked yet, so ask the teacher and close the gaps quickly.
finalExcellentBody: This subject is complete and has been entered in the main record at the highest level (Excellent).
finalVeryGoodBody: The subject is complete and archived. More effort next semester can raise it further.
finalPassBody: The result is locked. The next term still needs a stronger study plan.
finalFailBody: The final mark for this subject is locked at a low level. Speak with your homeroom teacher for extra support.
